errors.description: There is a harmless arithmetic error: (1-u)/2 has denominator 2^{n+1}-1, not 2^{n+1}. The subsequent bound on Liu follows correctly from D(A)≤u, so the proof is unaffected.

parsed.notes: The reduction, geometric lower bound via the forest component argument, and subset-sum/cross-pairing upper bound are otherwise rigorous and complete.
